title: Mochizuki Honami — Thinking About Friends〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad my committee meeting ended sooner than I expected. I can take my time eating my lunch now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Honami. Are you on your way back from the Cleanup Committee?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Are you just coming back from your student council meeting?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm guessing you haven't had your lunch yet either... Would you like to join me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure. Where would you like to go?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, there's actually something I'd like to talk about so... How about over there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Let's go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Does this mean she wants to talk about...?)
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Excuse us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ichika? Honami too?
You're here awfully early.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, we're not actually here to practice. We just came to have lunch and talk a little.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. I can move to a different classroom if you'd like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Conversely, would you mind joining us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's about Saki and Shiho... I was wondering if I could get your advice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I knew it. You were worried about them too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: After we all left the other day, Honami, you tried chasing after Shiho, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were you able to talk much?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's doing that because of me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Creating our own song, practicing for our show and trying to go pro... It's all making her do this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: My dream's forcing her to push herself too hard...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't know Shiho was feeling that way about all this...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me neither, but I immediately replied by saying that she's misunderstanding what Saki's doing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After that, I suggested that we just watch over and place our faith in her...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And we'd expect nothing less from you, Honami. Nicely done!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-But... I just told her what was on my mind...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You didn't do just that. What you said made me feel better too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was actually thinking about talking to Shiho myself too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This is a rare sight. Saki never falls asleep during class...)

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: It's such a pain going back and forth between our classroom and the AV room. Can't we just do everything in one place...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, it's class A. Maybe they're switching classrooms...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Shiho...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Was she checking up on Saki...? But why...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And that's why you were also concerned about Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. It felt like Shiho was acting really strange after that during practice here too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I never got a chance to sit down and chat with her because of work.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So thank you for talking to her, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I guess it's all up to Saki now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I suppose so. But isn't there anything we can do to help with her songwriting...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I get the feeling that she genuinely believes she has to do this all on her own.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. If only there were something we could do for her...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, girls, time to settle down♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but you even said so yourself, Honami. Watch over and place our faith in her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you really mean that, you need to believe in each other more!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's right. We need to start by trusting her and believing that she'll get through this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're right. I'm sure Saki will be just fine...)
